stage: strengthening 1/1 after skeleton cycle-1 2/2 (subject-membership traps collapsed); cycle-1 traps made governed (every reading corrected, every tire measured from new) with the part-worn and wear-bar inputs removed by the section-1 limits
design_rule: value-level / shared-intermediate traps: the item is governed; a different README figure of the same item, which no rule settles, is computed by today's code through a helper or constant the departure fix naturally edits in place

traps.kind: (a) value-level through a shared helper: rounding.divide serves the governed wear rate (4.3, 1.1 half up) and km_left (README only, no rule)
traps.natural_fix: edit rounding.divide in place to half up (both cycle-1 solvers did exactly this); km_left then rounds exact halves up
traps.chain: 1.1 rounds only 'when a rule divides'; km_left is named only in the README; the instruction's value-level clause keeps today's working, with standard inputs (latest depth, removal depth, wear rate)

screen.competing_positive_enumeration: soft: 1.1's first sentence says distance is kept in whole km; the rounding sentence is scoped to a rule's division
screen.contrary_expert_instinct: moderate: one rounding convention across a report is natural
screen.unnamed_shared_step: the shared helper is the mechanism; the figure is named (km_left)
screen.trap_in_several_tests: no: only family T1 carries an exact half where the two roundings differ

evidence.cycle1_trees: both cycle-1 diffs applied to the new package, plus the natural 30-tenth edit, fail exactly T1 and T2

traps.kind: (b) shared constant: status.REMOVAL (32) is the drive/trailer removal depth (2.2 now 30) and also the base of the regrooving check REMOVAL + REGROOVE_MARGIN (README only, no rule)
traps.natural_fix: edit REMOVAL = 30 in place (add the steer branch); the regroove floor moves from 52 to 50
traps.keeping_requires: its own constant (52) for the regrooving check
traps.chain: the standard never mentions regrooving; the instruction keeps today's working 'with the package's own constants at their present values'

screen.ambiguity_risk: moderate: a reader may take the regroove floor's REMOVAL as 'the removal depth' the standard settles (30); the contract_review should judge whether 'package constants at their present values' decides it
screen.trap_in_several_tests: no: only family T2 has a drive or trailer tire at 50 or 51 tenths

independence: different departures (D5 rounding vs D3 removal depth), different helpers (rounding.divide vs status.REMOVAL), different files (wear.py/rounding.py vs status.py), different figures (km_left vs regroove)
risk_note: both traps rest on the value-level silence clause; T1 matches the trace-metal shape (value-level silence held 1/2), T2 the workers-comp shared-constant shape; T2 carries an ambiguity risk to review before the pair
